Daily Devotional

November 14

22 Abstain from all appearance of evil. 23 And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. (1 Thessalonians 5:22-23 KJV)

This verse is telling us not only to abstain from evil, but also to abstain from even the appearance of evil. There are many times that Paul taught the same thing. It is not enough to just be living right in the sight of God, but we must live a life that is void of even the appearance of evil, so that we will be a light shinning in this dark world (Matthew 5:16). If people think you are living a sinful life, then they are not impressed with the Christian life at all. All those in ministry should be sure and live a life that will glorify God, so that we can bring other non-believers to the faith. Many well known preachers have fallen into sin, and it is a poor testimony to Christianity for this to happen. Live a holy life, because Jesus is Holy (1 Peter 1:16), and to show that you are truly Christ Like, not to earn anything from God, but to let your light shine for Him.

If we are born again, then our spirits are brand new, and are as holy and righteous as Jesus is (Galatians 4:6), but our bodies and souls have not been redeemed yet, and will not be changed until Jesus comes again (1 Corinthians 13:12). The only way that our bodies and souls can be changed in this life is for us to renew our minds by studying the Word of God (Romans 12:2), and dying to ourselves, so that Jesus can live through us. As long as we don’t renew our minds, we will tend to continue in worldly living, and Satan will be able to wreck havoc in our lives (John 10:10). This verse tells us that we are a three-part creature, if born again, and consist of spirit, soul and body. Live your life for God, and reap the fruitful life that He has for us. God does not respond to your holy living, but if you truly have been born again, you will want to please Him. Live holy because you love Him.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
